question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: '**till**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Till **is used to indicate a point in time up to which an action or situation continues.

 
 
• **Example**: *I will wait till 5 p.m.*
 
 
 
• In this given context, "**Till**" is used here to express the time frame between the drivers staying stationary and the arrival of the police.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Besides **is used to mean "in addition to" or "apart from.

 
 
• **For example**: *Besides studying, she also enjoys painting.*
 
 
 
• **For **is used to indicate a duration of time or purpose.
 
 
• **For example**: *I will be away for a week (duration) or This gift is for you (purpose).*
 
 
 
• **Along **is used to indicate movement or progress in a particular direction, often in a linear fashion.
 
 
• **For example**: *We walked along the beach.*
